Specifications.Display: Brilliant 10.1” 1080p display (1920 x 1200) with over 2 million pixels (224 ppi), for bright, vivid image quality. Screen strengthened with aluminosilicate glass.
Specifications.Weight: 15.29 oz (433.6g) Actual size and weight may vary by configuration and manufacturing process
Specifications.CPU & RAM:
Octa-core processor – 2x Arm Cortex-A76 up to 2.05 Ghz and 6x Arm Cortex A55 up to 2Ghz
3 GB RAM
Specifications.Storage: 32 GB (24 GB available to user) or 64 GB (54.3 GB available to user) of internal storage. Add micro-SD slot for up to 1 TB of additional storage. Some apps may require that they are installed on internal storage. App or feature updates may impact available storage.
Specifications.Battery Life: Up to 13 hours of reading, browsing the web, watching videos, and listening to music. Battery life will vary based on device settings, usage, and other factors such as web browsing and downloading content. Certain software features or apps may reduce battery life.
Specifications.Charge Time: Fully charge in under 4 hours with USB-C cable and 9W power adapter included in the box. Fully charge in under 3 hours with 15W adapter and USB type C to C cable (adapter and cable sold separately).
Specifications.Wi-Fi Connectivity: Dual-band wifi. Supports public and private wifi networks or hotspots that use the dual-band 802.11a/b/g/n/ac standards with support for security standard of WEP, WPA3 OWE, WPA/WPA2/WPA3 Personal and WPA/WPA2/WPA3 Enterprise. Wi-Fi 6 (802.11 ax) is currently not supported.
Specifications.Ports: USB-C (2.0) connector for charging; micro-SD slot for external storage
Specifications.Audio: 3.5 mm stereo jack, dual integrated speakers; external volume controls
Specifications.Camera Specs: 5 MP front and rear-facing cameras with 1080p HD video recording
Specifications.Printing: Printing documents to a nearby wifi enabled printer is supported
Specifications.Certifications:
Fire HD 10 has received the following certifications:
ENERGY STAR
USI2.0 for stylus protocol
Recycled Content Certification for Electrical and Electronic Equipment (RCCEEE)
Specifications.Bluetooth: Built-in Bluetooth 5.3 with support for A2DP compatible stereo headphones, speakers, microphone, and LE accessories support
Specifications.Included in the Box: Fire HD 10 tablet, USB-C (2.0) cable, 9W power adapter, and Quick Start Guide
